2.text: “Mbese wibwira yuko ibyo bitunganye, ubwo wavuze uti‘Gukiranuka kwanjye kuruta ukw'Imana’?

3.text: Kuko wavuze uti ‘Kuzamarira iki?’Kandi uti‘Nzabona nyungu ki ziruta izo mba narabonye ngikora ibyaha?’

4.text: Ngiye kugusubiza wowe na bagenzi bawe.

5.text: “Itegereze mu ijuru urebe,Kandi witegereze ibicu biri hejuru uko bigusumba.

6.text: Niba warakoze icyaha hari icyo uyitwaye?Kandi ibicumuro byawe niba byaragwiriye na byo biyitwaye iki?

7.text: Niba uri umukiranutsi hari icyo uyihaye?Cyangwa se icyo ihabwa n'ukuboko kwawe ni iki?

8.text: Icyakora ibibi byawe byababaza umuntu umeze nkawe,Kandi umwana w'umuntu gukiranuka kwawe ni we kwagira icyo kumumarira.

9.text: “Batakishwa no kurengana kwinshi,Ku bwo kubabazwa n'amaboko y'abakomeye ni cyo kibatera gutabaza.

10.text: Ariko nta wavuga ati ‘Imana Umuremyi wanjye iri he?Kandi ari yo iduha indirimbo mu ijoro,

11.text: Ikatwigisha kuruta inyamaswa zo mu isi,Kandi ikaduha ubwenge kuruta ibisiga byo mu kirere.’

12.text: Nuko barataka ariko ntihagira ubasubiza,Bitewe n'ubwibone bw'abanyabyaha.

13.text: Ni ukuri Imana ntiyumvira ibyo ubusa.Ndetse Ishoborabyose ntiyabyitaho.

14.text: “Nubwo uvuga ko utayireba,Ariko urubanza ruri imbere yayo,Nawe uyirindīra.

15.text: Ariko noneho kuko idahōresha uburakari bwayo,Ntiyite ku gasuzuguro cyane,

16.text: Ni cyo cyatumye Yobu abumburira ubusa akanwa ke,Akagwiza amagambo atagira icyo azi.”
